b: Here is the latest in my Empathetic Robot series of oil paintings. Finished in time for IlluxCon last month and will be appearing this coming weekend at Philcon, the literary Science Fiction convention held in Cherry Hill, NJ (just outside Philadelphia).
As is typical with my approach, the initial concept for this piece began as a small abstract in my sketchbook, progressing into the larger preliminary, and finally into color and paint.

A little out of the ordinary was the long delay from when the final preliminary was finished and mounted to the board, and when I finally carved out the time to execute the work in color – this time it was close to a full year delay.
Disruptor, preliminary drawing, graphite and chalk on toned paper 2025

Usually I like to jump into the final step immediately after the drawing is finished, riding the wave of research inspiration which helped assemble the references for the final choices in design and composition. Acting while the concept and themes are fresh in my mind.

But commissions necessitated the delay, and a lucky discovery at another art exhibition earlier this summer gave me the idea to use a ‘hot’ color scheme – leaning in heavily on the yellow and oranges.
I usually do not like to explain or discuss these works from the series, preferring to let viewers interpret what they are seeing/feeling. But I will preface this piece with stating:
The current use of A.I. softwares as structured by large companies is based upon outright criminal activity.
These large companies have knowingly and willingly stolen trillions of dollars of copyrighted material all under the lie that they were ‘training’ their softwares.
The softwares all COPIED and RESTRUCTURED the data they had access to and the companies have been shielded by complicit governments and politicians as they hide behind the lie of machine learning.

The existence of hundreds of massive ‘Data Centers’ belies the narrative that there was no ‘learning’ but rather data reformatting, copying, storage, and re-access as the true nature of this A.I. build out.
These companies are criminals and need to be fully prosecuted, their assets confiscated, and profits and value of their theft redistributed to the creatives and individuals from whom they stole from.
I will NOT use A.I. pirating softwares in the process of ANYTHING which I create.
Disruptor, 36″ x 24″ Oil on Panel. Final.
